arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import importlib,hashlib
m=importlib.import_module('ptyprocess.ptyprocess')
actual=Path(m.__file__).resolve();expected=(Path.cwd()/'ptyprocess/ptyprocess.py').resolve()
assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
print('source_binding',actual,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
from ptyprocess import PtyProcess
proc=PtyProcess.spawn(['sleep','5'])
try:
    proc.setecho(False)
    first=proc.waitnoecho(timeout=5)
    proc.setecho(True)
    second=proc.waitnoecho(timeout=1)
    proc.setecho(False)
    third=proc.waitnoecho(timeout=5)
    print('waitnoecho_invert_sequence',[first,second,third])
    assert [first,second,third]==[True,False,True]
finally:
    try: proc.terminate(force=True)
    except Exception: pass
    try: proc.wait()
    except Exception: pass
    try: proc.close()
    except Exception: pass
PYREPLAY
